items.title: How Tripo Is Tackling Clean Topology for its 3D Asset Pipeline
items.excerpt: Tripo co-founder Dr. Yanpei Cao explains Smart Mesh, generating usable topology in seconds, and giving artists control over AI-generated assets. He frames the shift from single-asset generation toward complete interactive worlds.
items.why: AI 3D generation finally producing production-usable topology directly changes how VFX/animation artists bring generated assets into a film pipeline.

items.title: Utopai Is 'World's Largest Independent AI-Native Film and TV Studio,' Will Premiere 3 Movies and 2 Series in 2027
items.excerpt: Utopai Studios says it has 25 original projects in production on its AI-native pipeline, with three films and two series slated for 2027 premieres.
items.why: A concrete production slate — not a demo — shows what an end-to-end AI-native studio pipeline actually commits to shipping.

items.title: Motion Picture Association Inks AI IP Protection Deal With ByteDance
items.excerpt: The agreement covers ByteDance's Seedance video models plus TikTok and other products, setting a framework for protecting studio IP inside generative video tools.
items.why: Sets the rules of engagement for the video model most creatives are already using — what you can legally generate and ship changes with it.

items.title: Val Kilmer Resurrected by AI: 'As Deep as the Grave' Releases Seven Minutes of Footage
items.excerpt: Seven minutes of footage shows an AI-generated younger Val Kilmer performing as Father Fintan, the late actor's final screen 'performance'.
items.why: The clearest public look yet at synthetic performance quality — the benchmark every de-aging and likeness pipeline is now measured against.

items.title: “Saying you're working with AI is like saying you have an STD,” argues Tilly Norwood creator
items.excerpt: Eline van der Velden says she has signed hundreds of NDAs with companies quietly exploring AI, and urges public broadcasters to invest openly in the space.
items.why: Names the disclosure taboo directly: most productions already use AI but won't say so, which shapes how creative teams document their own workflows.

items.title: Former Pact CEO John McVay joins AI skills platform Aimici
items.excerpt: The veteran UK producers' trade body chief joins Aimici, a platform focused on AI skills training for the screen industries, and will later take over as chair.
items.why: Signals that AI upskilling is becoming formal infrastructure for production crews, not an individual side project.

items.title: Adobe Firefly Overhauls Its Audio Capabilities With Music, Speech, and Sound Effects All Now in One Place
items.excerpt: Firefly's Generate Music, Generate Speech and Generate Sound Effects go generally available, sized to a video's length and mood, with ElevenLabs voices as an option.
items.why: Temp-score and scratch-VO work move inside the same tool as the picture edit, collapsing a whole outsourced step of post.

items.title: Meet the Artists Behind the Emmy-Nominated VFX on 'Gen V'
items.excerpt: The Gen V VFX team breaks down the mix of practical and digital techniques used to make Season 2's superpowered chaos read as real.
items.why: A working account of where artists still choose practical over digital — the judgment call AI tools keep pushing on.

items.title: George Clooney, Maggie Gyllenhaal Set For Venice CAA Forum
items.excerpt: The CAA-Finch & Partners forum at Venice convenes filmmakers, writers and technologists for a day on what AI means for creativity and which tools might actually support artists.
items.why: A major festival stages the AI-and-craft argument as programming, not a side panel — a read on where the industry conversation lands next.

items.title: That time Bill Nighy wore 'computer pajamas'
items.excerpt: How Davy Jones was brought to life in 'Dead Man's Chest' through Bill Nighy's on-set performance capture suit and ILM's then-new facial VFX innovations.
items.why: The origin story of performance-driven digital characters — useful context for judging what today's AI face tools do and don't inherit.

items.title: Don't miss ILP's VFX breakdown for 'The Mandalorian and Grogu'
items.excerpt: Important Looking Pirates shares its environment work and Zeb creature shots from the new Mandalorian feature.
items.why: Shot-level breakdowns are the reference point crews use to calibrate what generated environments still can't match.

items.title: VFX breakdown: 'Star City' by DNEG
items.excerpt: DNEG goes behind the scenes on its visual effects work for 'Star City'.
items.why: A current large-facility pipeline on display — the baseline any AI-assisted shot has to slot into.

items.title: Phil Tippett Closes Berkeley Studio After Nearly 40 Years
items.excerpt: The Oscar-winning animation and VFX pioneer is auctioning decades of artifacts as he closes his Berkeley studio, though he says he won't retire: “I will die with my sword in my hand.”
items.why: A landmark practical-effects house shutting its doors marks how fast the economics under hand-built creature work have moved.

items.title: 'Coyote Vs. Acme's' Dave Green On Creating A Sympathetic Wile E.
items.excerpt: Director Dave Green explains how story artists, a life-size puppet and classic cartoon flashbacks turned a silent slapstick icon into the emotional center of the film.
items.why: Character design decisions made by hand and puppet, laid out step by step — a concrete counter-model to prompt-first character work.

items.title: VES Awards Add New Categories For Animation And Short-Form VFX
items.excerpt: Animated series will compete alongside features under revised rules that also split CG cinematography into separate animation and photoreal categories, plus a new in-camera effects award.
items.why: Award taxonomy is how the craft defines itself — new in-camera and short-form categories show which work the field wants to protect.

items.title: Emmy: 'Alien: Earth' VFX Supervisor Aladino Debert Talks Workflow
items.excerpt: Debert walks through the VFX workflow behind Noah Hawley's eight-episode sci-fi horror series set two years before the original Alien.
items.why: Supervisor-level detail on how a modern episodic VFX pipeline is actually sequenced and staffed.

items.title: Emmy-Nominated DP Marshall Adams on 'Pluribus' Look, Workflow
items.excerpt: The cinematographer of Vince Gilligan's Apple TV series details how the show's look was built and carried through post.
items.why: Look development as a deliberate authored system — the part of the craft generative tools are least able to hold consistent.

items.title: Mocha — An express tracking tutorial for After Effects
items.excerpt: Chris Zwar walks through planar tracking in Mocha for After Effects, covering motion graphics inserts, stabilisation and reverse stabilisation for VFX.
items.why: Tracking is the step AI roto tools keep promising to automate; knowing the manual method is what makes the automated result checkable.

items.title: Watch: How WeFX Brought 'From' Season 4's Monsters to Life
items.excerpt: WeFX reveals the VFX work behind FROM Season 4 on MGM+, from eight-foot dolls to ominous crows.
items.why: A mid-size vendor showing its shot logic — the tier of studio most exposed to AI-assisted creature and crowd work.

items.title: Stop-Motion Hybrid Adaptation 'Lincoln in the Bardo' Casts Willem Dafoe, Jonathan Bailey & Peter Dinklage
items.excerpt: Based on George Saunders' novel, the hybrid stop-motion feature blends fact and imagination around a moment in Lincoln's life.
items.why: A major hybrid stop-motion greenlight shows handmade technique still winning prestige projects as generative animation scales.

items.title: Base FX Works On Creatures Big And Small For 'Beef' Season 2
items.excerpt: Base FX brings ants, bees, a coyote attack and CG aircraft to Beef Season 2, turning revenge into a visual playground.
items.why: Small-creature and insect work is exactly where simulation and generated imagery compete; this shows the current hand-built bar.

items.title: Creating Continuity Across Decades For 'The House Of The Spirits'
items.excerpt: Garagevfx builds realistic digital environments, CGI animals and decades-spanning continuity for the adaptation of Isabel Allende's novel.
items.why: Aging characters and eras across decades is the classic de-aging brief — worth reading against what AI face tools now claim.

items.title: Flying Bark Enters the Avatar State with 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender'
items.excerpt: Animation director Christian Barkel and CEO Barbara Stephen break down the hybrid 2D/CG workflow behind the new feature: three years of new tools, no rigs, and every movement drawn by hand.
items.why: A studio built custom tooling to keep hand-drawn motion at feature scale — a working answer to 'automate it or author it'.

items.title: How 'Spider-Noir' Shot 1933 New York Twice
items.excerpt: The VFX team explains building 1933 New York in both color and black-and-white passes for the series' dual-version release.
items.why: Delivering two graded worlds from one shoot is a pipeline design problem — the kind AI color and relighting tools are aimed at.
